provenance.reference: Reference Paper.pdf, Appendix C.1; Reference Paper Codes/ANN/network.py
provenance.adaptation: PyTorch port; not a bit-identical replay of TensorFlow 1 Adam
provenance.our_choices: Batch size, step ceiling, validation cadence, early stopping, group splits, fixed-edge selection, seeds, and checkpoint protocol are our choices. Early stopping uses validation MSE only, after a minimum 10000 updates, with 20-check patience and absolute min_delta 1e-6. The visible supplied graph uses Adam at 1e-5; historical training loop settings are unavailable.
provenance.scope: Magnitude regression on known-field Monte Carlo estimators; signs and iterative correction are separate steps. No recovered historical phase filter.
